title: Claude Code + PCG Infinite Maze
author: Decagones
selftext:
My first session with Claude Code in Unreal Engine 5.8 left me with mixed feelings.  
  
I've been learning UE and Blueprints for the past five years or so, mostly through YouTube tutorials and official documentation. The majority of the work I've done has been built from scratch, node by node. That was my way of learning and understanding what was actually being built.  
  
Using Claude Code reduced the importance of those layers of knowledge to almost zero. I'm reading what the agent is doing, and I'm reviewing the work, but I'm not really learning anything. I don't need to dig too deep into my memory to direct it, either.  
  
I'd like to think that, on a few occasions, my knowledge of Blueprints and logical thinking led to better results, but I'm not entirely sure.  
  
I still want to continue developing my project the old way. That said, this devil of a thing has definitely grabbed my attention.
